name: Jiahe Foods Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating within China, Jiahe Foods Industry Co., Ltd. specializes in the production and distribution of various food ingredients. Its diverse product portfolio includes concentrated coffee liquid and instant coffee powders. Moreover, the company supplies non-dairy creamers, which are integral components for a wide array of applications such as bakery items, condiment and soup bases, formula milk powder, cold-soluble food products, oatmeal, coffee, and milk tea. The company was established in 2001 and its corporate headquarters are situated in Suzhou, China.
